messages.author: 31dc03607958a62a
messages.subject: Problems : Only the first iteration of my models runs after 9 hours of time
parts:
Hi Ratan's users,

I wrote the hierarchical model below from the accompanying chart. 
My problem is that after 9 hours of time, only the first iteration appears.

It seems surprising, and could you tell me if there is an error in my script.

data {

  int P; // # Individus

  int Q; // # Items

  real LogTimesNA[P,Q]; // Log responses times

  real IndNA[P,Q]; // NA index  (1 if NA, 0 ifelse)

  int ItemsNA[P,Q]; // Responses

  

}



parameters {

vector[2] paramP[P]; // Parameters of persons (theta,tau)

vector[2] paramQ[Q]; // Parameters of items (betaR,betaT)

  

vector[2] muP; // mean of multivariate normal for parameters (theta, tau) of persons

cholesky_factor_corr[2] L_OmegaP; 

real<lower=0> sigmaP2; 

vector[2] muQ; // mean of multivariate normal for parameters (betaR, betaT) of items

cholesky_factor_corr[2] L_OmegaQ; 

vector<lower=0>[2] sigmaQ;

  

        vector<lower=0>[Q] sigmaT; // variance of Log times

}



model {

        // I create vector sigmaP to fix sigmaP[1] = 1

vector[2] sigmaP;

  sigmaP[1] <- 1;

  sigmaP[2] <- sigmaP2;

 

        // Priors

        muP ~ normal(0,inv_sqrt(0.001));

        sigmaP2 ~ cauchy(0,2.5);

  L_OmegaP ~ lkj_corr_cholesky(2);

   

        muQ ~ normal(0,inv_sqrt(0.001));

        L_OmegaQ ~ lkj_corr_cholesky(2);

        sigmaQ ~ cauchy(0,2.5);

    

        sigmaT ~ cauchy(0,2.5);

    

for(p in 1:P)

  {

paramP[p] ~ multi_normal_cholesky(muP,diag_pre_multiply(sigmaP,L_OmegaP));

            for(q in 1:Q)

            {

                paramQ[q] ~ multi_normal_cholesky(muP,diag_pre_multiply(sigmaQ,L_OmegaQ));

              if(IndNA[p,q]==0)

              {

                        ItemsNA[p,q] ~ bernoulli_logit(paramP[p,1]-paramQ[q,1]);

        LogTimesNA[p,q] ~ normal(paramQ[q,2] - paramP[p,2],sigmaT[q]);

        }

        }

        }

}


Bests regards

messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Problems : Only the first iteration of my models runs after 9 hours of time
parts:
Hi All,

I modified the model with suggestion's Mike  and it works. However the convergence of the estimations are not possible.

To do this, I generate 2 datas, responses and responses times given parameters. So, I tried to find them. But I can not.

If you put files in the same environment, you can use only StanExcution.R to create datas and to do estimations.

File StanExecution.R Generate the datas and excute the model to estimate the parameters
File S1M_TimeResponseDependent.stan contains the model
File FunctionItemsLogTimesData.R contains different functions used in file StanExecution.R 
File FunctionsThesisStart.R contains different functions used in file StanExecution.R

data {
    int P; // # Individus
   int Q; // # Items
   real LogTimesNA[P,Q]; // Log responses times
   real IndNA[P,Q]; // NA index  (1 if NA, 0 ifelse)
   int ItemsNA[P,Q]; // Responses
  
}


parameters {
    vector[2] paramP[P]; // Parameters of persons (theta,tau)
  vector[2] paramQ[Q]; // Parameters of items (betaR,betaT)
  
  vector[2] muP;

cholesky_factor_corr[2] L_OmegaP;
  real<lower=0> sigmaP2; 
  vector[2] muQ;

cholesky_factor_corr[2] L_OmegaQ;
  vector<lower=0>[2] sigmaQ;
  
    vector<lower=0>[Q] sigmaT;
}

transformed parameters{
    matrix[2,2] LP;
    matrix[2,2] LQ;

vector[2] sigmaP;
    sigmaP[1] <- 1;
    sigmaP[2] <- sigmaP2;

LP <- diag_pre_multiply(sigmaP,L_OmegaP);
    LQ <- diag_pre_multiply(sigmaQ,L_OmegaQ);
}

model {
  
   // Priors
   muP ~ normal(0,1);
    sigmaP2 ~ invgamma(0.001,0.001);
   L_OmegaP ~ lkj_corr_cholesky(1);
   
    muQ ~ normal(0,1);
    L_OmegaQ ~ lkj_corr_cholesky(1);
    sigmaQ ~ invgamma(0.001,0.001);
    
    sigmaT ~ invgamma(0.001,0.001);
    
    
// 1st level
  for(p in 1:P)
   {
       for(q in 1:Q)
       {

if(IndNA[p,q]==0)
         {
             ItemsNA[p,q] ~ bernoulli_logit(paramP[p,1]-paramQ[q,1]);
        LogTimesNA[p,q] ~ normal(paramQ[q,2] - paramP[p,2],sigmaT[q]);
      }
    }
   }

// 2nd level
   paramP ~ multi_normal_cholesky(muP,LP);
   paramQ ~ multi_normal_cholesky(muQ,LQ);
}

Bests regards

messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Problems : Only the first iteration of my models runs after 9 hours of time
parts: Let's keep the discussion of this topic on the other thread ("Just first iteration with Hierarchical model responses and response times") since that's where Bob & I initially replied.

On Thu, Jun 9, 2016 at 2:35 AM, Eric Innocents EBOULET <ericinnoce...@gmail.com> wrote:
Hi All,

I modified the model with suggestion's Mike  and it works. However the convergence of the estimations are not possible.

To do this, I generate 2 datas, responses and responses times given parameters. So, I tried to find them. But I can not.

If you put files in the same environment, you can use only StanExcution.R to create datas and to do estimations.

File StanExecution.R Generate the datas and excute the model to estimate the parameters
File S1M_TimeResponseDependent.stan contains the model
File FunctionItemsLogTimesData.R contains different functions used in file StanExecution.R 
File FunctionsThesisStart.R contains different functions used in file StanExecution.R 

data {
    int P; // # Individus
   int Q; // # Items
   real LogTimesNA[P,Q]; // Log responses times
   real IndNA[P,Q]; // NA index  (1 if NA, 0 ifelse)
   int ItemsNA[P,Q]; // Responses
  
}


parameters {
    vector[2] paramP[P]; // Parameters of persons (theta,tau)
  vector[2] paramQ[Q]; // Parameters of items (betaR,betaT)
  
  vector[2] muP;
  cholesky_factor_corr[2] L_OmegaP;
  real<lower=0> sigmaP2; 
  vector[2] muQ;
  cholesky_factor_corr[2] L_OmegaQ;
  vector<lower=0>[2] sigmaQ;
  
    vector<lower=0>[Q] sigmaT;
}

transformed parameters{
    matrix[2,2] LP;
    matrix[2,2] LQ;
  
    vector[2] sigmaP;
    sigmaP[1] <- 1;
    sigmaP[2] <- sigmaP2;
  
    LP <- diag_pre_multiply(sigmaP,L_OmegaP);
    LQ <- diag_pre_multiply(sigmaQ,L_OmegaQ);
}

model {
  
   // Priors
   muP ~ normal(0,1);
    sigmaP2 ~ invgamma(0.001,0.001);
   L_OmegaP ~ lkj_corr_cholesky(1);
   
    muQ ~ normal(0,1);
    L_OmegaQ ~ lkj_corr_cholesky(1);
    sigmaQ ~ invgamma(0.001,0.001);
    
    sigmaT ~ invgamma(0.001,0.001);
    
    
// 1st level
  for(p in 1:P)
   {
       for(q in 1:Q)
       {
         if(IndNA[p,q]==0)
         {
             ItemsNA[p,q] ~ bernoulli_logit(paramP[p,1]-paramQ[q,1]);
        LogTimesNA[p,q] ~ normal(paramQ[q,2] - paramP[p,2],sigmaT[q]);
      }
    }
   }
  
   // 2nd level
   paramP ~ multi_normal_cholesky(muP,LP);
   paramQ ~ multi_normal_cholesky(muQ,LQ);
}

Bests regards
